proposal.reason: Main change is new host one-sided RMA Put/Signal/Wait execution over CE/DMA (new rma_ce launch/init/finalize paths, signal/ack synchronization, chunked puts), which maps to copy-engine. enqueue is additionally needed because the PR adds a new RMA task type, planner queues, plan scheduling, and launch-path integration. device-api is additionally needed because public one-sided APIs and symmetric-window/LSA validation semantics are introduced and wired through window/runtime structures. communicator is additionally needed for communicator-level capability gating and lifecycle/config integration (hostRmaSupport platform checks, numRmaCtx parsing/defaults, init/finalize hooks).
